title: The World Is Slowly Awakening
subtitle: A Path Through Twelve Doors
canonBoundary: Deed numbers and five signs are canonical. Chapter titles, themes, mechanics, and narrative beats are game adaptations by Toadaid.
selectionPrinciple: These twelve deeds form one meaningful path through Tobyworld. Unselected deeds remain distinct doors and are not lesser, duplicate, or absent from the world.

acts.title: Act I — Learning to Tend
acts.purpose: Toby learns that awakening a land requires attention rather than conquest.

chapters.title: Paths of Patience
chapters.mechanicSeed: Waystone route memory and Satoby guidance
chapters.storyBeat: Toby learns to stop, listen, tend, and Yield.

chapters.title: Frostveil Crossing
chapters.mechanicSeed: Frozen crossings and narrow timing windows
chapters.storyBeat: The first lesson survives a harsher land.

chapters.title: Stillwater Dawn
chapters.mechanicSeed: Reflections, stillness, and Hush quieting threats
chapters.storyBeat: Silence becomes a way of hearing the land.

chapters.title: Cloudwake Ascent
chapters.mechanicSeed: A divided Sunfield and OG's Sky Ward
chapters.storyBeat: Toby crosses the open sky and learns that courage can be sheltered.

acts.title: Act II — The Scattered Signs
acts.purpose: Relics reveal that the awakened doors answer one another across Tobyworld.

chapters.title: Garden of the Shard
chapters.mechanicSeed: Sporegrove paths spread and retract around an Ancient Rune
chapters.storyBeat: A Shard answers the four awakened Cores with a distant light.

chapters.title: The Ember Oath
chapters.mechanicSeed: Emberreach heat cycles and rune-cooled safe paths
chapters.storyBeat: OG teaches that protection creates time to choose, not permission to rush.

chapters.title: The Box Beneath the Moon
chapters.mechanicSeed: Mossmere concealment and a Kiribako memory sequence
chapters.storyBeat: The Kiribako preserves an echo from a door Toby has not entered.

chapters.title: The Meadow Gate
chapters.mechanicSeed: Open Meadow sightlines and Gate Key route changes
chapters.storyBeat: A simple field reveals the first key toward The Pond.

acts.title: Act III — The Way Home
acts.purpose: The route bends toward The Pond, where the path is revealed as one thread in a world of doors.

chapters.title: The Map in the Frost
chapters.mechanicSeed: Cloudwake Frostveil navigation guided by the Lore Map
chapters.storyBeat: The Lore Map shows no center—only connected doors.

chapters.title: The Key Below Stillwater
chapters.mechanicSeed: Reflected routes reveal a submerged Gate Key
chapters.storyBeat: Hush asks Toby to trust what can be seen only while still.

chapters.title: At the Pond's Threshold
chapters.mechanicSeed: Pond rings open through patient breathing; Satoby's welcome opens them permanently
chapters.storyBeat: The key opens a threshold, not ownership of what waits beyond.

chapters.title: The Pond Remembers
chapters.mechanicSeed: The Wayfinder reveals three Door Echoes awakened through still, held Patience
chapters.storyBeat: The final Wayfinder reveals that every deed remains its own door and every land belongs to Tobyworld.
